Hi, I am Nastia Tulayeva.
I design digital things that people interact with.

Product designer with 6 years of experience. I work on products from concept to launch. Currently at The Norm.

The portfolio needs a refresh and is under construction.

Some links to what I’ve been up to over the last 5 years:

  • User Interface Designer’s Reference, where I am a Swiss Army knife designer, editor and manager. Made with Ilya Birman and Aleksandra Ozkan at Bureau Gorbunov School (Russian only).
  • AutoQA, initial Conversation Analytics and a bunch of other things for MaxContact
  • Dozens of projects for Coherent Solutions and The Norm clients.
  • Apartment sales study dashboard.
  • Minsk Warhammer league rating dashboard (please don’t ask).
  • UX Lean Coffee, where I initiate and facilitate meetings (currently on hold).
  • The Norm, Coherent Solutions design practice: led website, branding and illustrations production in 2025–2026.
  • Coherent Solutions website in 2023.
  • User research for foodtech startup SHLP, saving them a couple of thousand bucks.
  • Sometimes I mentor designers. Give me a shout if that sounds useful.

I focus on designing products that leverage the best from new technologies to help people do their jobs well. I design in Figma or with code: HTML/CSS, Claude Code, etc. I draw in Illustrator and Procreate.

I am capable of combining product design with product management responsibilities. As a graduate architect, I am a useful asset in products dedicated to emerging technologies in civil engineering, architecture, and urban design.

Be aware that I will frequently try to add some dataviz to your project because it’s cool.

When I’m not at work, I run, walk, read, write, and am learning to play the piano.
